review_findings_addressed.finding: EmuReady.selectGame required trimmed title equality for batch rows whose game object lacks metadata.steamAppId, so an AppID-confirmed Windows entry could be discarded for punctuation/accent differences.
review_findings_addressed.change: The games.batchBySteamAppIds row is keyed by the requested Steam AppID, so its game is selected as that Windows entry via matchedBySteamAppId=true without re-matching the title. All prior identity guards remain: APPROVED status, microsoft_windows system, UUID id, and any linked metadata.steamAppId must equal the requested AppID. Title equality remains only for the games.get title-search fallback.

review_findings_addressed.finding: CommunityReportsButton rendered on every Steam catalog details page, including apps Steam marks as non-Windows.
review_findings_addressed.change: Rendered only when game.windows != false. SteamCatalogItem.windows is Boolean? from the existing include_platforms data; known non-Windows apps hide the action, while unknown platform data keeps it so an absent field does not over-hide. A comment records the intent.

review_findings_addressed.finding: A missing Windows entry and several equally plausible Windows entries shared one message.
review_findings_addressed.change: Page carries ambiguous:Boolean=false. It is set only when the title-search fallback returns more than one acceptable candidate and none was selected. The modal shows a distinct wording for ambiguity and keeps the no-entry wording for a genuine miss.

review_findings_addressed.finding: Only appId>0 was guarded; a blank Steam title made EmuReady.reports require() throw and surface as a connection error.
review_findings_addressed.change: The button is not created when appId <= 0 or gameTitle.isBlank(), so the modal cannot be opened into that state.

review_findings_addressed.finding: A missing games.batchBySteamAppIds row threw instead of continuing to the games.get title search.
review_findings_addressed.change: A missing or unmatched batch row now means 'no game from the batch lookup' and processing continues into the title-search fallback. Malformed envelope/array shapes still fail as unexpected responses.

review_findings_addressed.finding: CommunityReports.kt hardcoded '—' fallbacks for blank performance/emulator values.
review_findings_addressed.change: The fallback text comes from the new string resource vapor_community_not_specified ('not specified'); the wording remains honest about missing report data.

review_findings_addressed.finding: Browse on EmuReady always used the Steam title, even when the matched EmuReady entry had a different title.
review_findings_addressed.change: The browse URL prefers page.game.title when it is non-blank and falls back to the Steam title while loading or when no entry matched.

review_findings_addressed.finding: Parse/shape failures were surfaced with the same 'Could not reach EmuReady' wording as transport failures.
review_findings_addressed.change: Shape/parse/limit failures throw EmuReady.UnexpectedResponseException (still an IOException). HTTP status failures and transport errors remain plain IOException. The modal tracks the two states separately and shows vapor_community_unexpected ('returned a response this app does not understand') for unreadable payloads, keeping 'Could not reach EmuReady' only for unreachable-service cases. Both states keep the retry action and never claim incompatibility.

review_findings_addressed.finding: ./gradlew :app:fetchLibretroDroid failed with java.io.IOException: Server returned HTTP response code: 406 for the pinned GitHub release URL, because URL.withInputStream sends the JDK default Accept header.
review_findings_addressed.change: FetchLibretroDroidTask.download now uses HttpURLConnection with explicit Accept: */* and User-Agent headers, bounded connect/read timeouts, redirects enabled, and a 2xx status check before streaming. The existing staging file, sha256 digest check, delete-on-mismatch, and rename-to-target flow are unchanged.
